title: Per-CELL census of EIGHT live BASKET heads never previously censused: does the basket-TRAIN screen's per-cell prediction hold on basket VALIDATION?
design_ref: S-347 (viability), S-354 (power, under the reader's statistic -- S-348's power is WITHDRAWN), S-349 (the reference key), S-352/S-353 (why the permutation statistic and the outcome table had to change), S-359 (R33)
statistical_unit: DOMAIN (PART I 3.1). Rows never inflate n.
endpoint: y_install via the concept-free semantic_one_word readout, cell C, n_examples 4

arms.BK_KO: --knockout-cells omitted = the all-32 band knockout; the denominator
arms.HD_<h>: all nine band cells of head h; the bar source AND the admission arm

CANDIDATE_PROVENANCE.nominated_on: the basket TRAIN screen (LAYER) and PR-CSI-012's basket whole-head magnitude (admission ELIGIBILITY). NEITHER uses any basket CELL data.
CANDIDATE_PROVENANCE.why_these_eight: live on basket validation (|E|/bar >= 1.5 on the S-311 rule applied to PR-CSI-012's SINGLE_<h> arms, ci95 excluding 0) AND never cell-censused

EXCLUDED_already_cell_mapped.why: PR-CSI-014 measured head 2's cells and PR-CSI-015 measured 17/19/23's. Counting a known outcome as a fresh draw is selection on data already read -- the same exclusion PR-CSI-018 applied to 17/19/23 on button.

CANDIDATE_PROVENANCE.⚠ WHY_NOT_THE_SCREEN_TOP_8: the four never-censused heads of the screen's top-8 (6, 13, 24, 28) predict {L9, L10, L10, L11}: heads 13 and 24 COLLIDE on L10, giving 12 distinct assignments and a permutation floor of 0.0833 > alpha. THAT FAMILY COULD NOT CERTIFY ON ANY OUTCOME (S-347). The pool was widened before any cell of any head here was measured.

⚠ PREDICTION_ALREADY_TESTED_ON_BUTTON.why_it_matters: the screen artefact is the SAME frozen file, so for these three this is a REPLICATION on a different population, not an independent draw. It is legitimate -- the prior is 'the screen is right', which is the hypothesis -- but it is a prior and it is named here rather than discovered afterwards.
⚠ PREDICTION_ALREADY_TESTED_ON_BUTTON.⚠ AND_THERE_IS_NO_SECONDARY_TO_FALL_BACK: the first freeze carried a five-head SECONDARY; R32-A showed nothing could compute it and its anti-fallback guard did not bind. It is DELETED. These three heads are in the primary and nowhere else.

CANDIDATE_PROVENANCE.⚠ HEAD_18_PREDICTS_L14: the band-edge rival. PR-CSI-018 excluded head 16 for this, correctly, where a small set could not be told from top-of-band bias. Here the eight predictions span SIX distinct layers, so the spanning rule and the permutation p both bite. Head 18 is INCLUDED and this rule is frozen BEFORE any cell is measured; dropping it after seeing the composition would be post-hoc selection.

SCREEN_PREDICTIONS_ON_RECORD_BEFORE_THIS.RE_DERIVED_BY_THIS_SCRIPT: yes -- from AtP_by_cell, not copied from any entry

PRIMARY.statistic: M = number of ADMITTED heads whose argmax band layer by |E| equals that head's frozen screen-predicted layer
PRIMARY.null: the screen's per-cell prediction is unrelated to the basket depth profile
PRIMARY.conditional: the same over ADMITTED heads whose predicted layer is unique among the admitted set

permutation.DEFINITION_VERBATIM: p_perm = the fraction of the DISTINCT assignments q of the prediction multiset to the admitted heads for which #{i : q_i == the OBSERVED argmax layer of head i} >= M
permutation.⚠ WHAT_IT_IS_COMPARED_AGAINST: the OBSERVED ARGMAX VECTOR, not the prediction vector. S-352: the first freeze of this family compared against the predictions, which is a DIFFERENT statistic -- they coincide only at M = K, and on one measured case the two gave 0.000099..0.000595 against 0.002679. The reader (scripts/dcs_csi_pr016_argmax_test.py) has always used the observed vector; this text now matches it, and THAT is the statistic.

ALL_THREE_FLOORS_AT_K8.why_all_three: the WEAKEST gates, so recording only the permutation floor (as the first freeze did) omits the one that actually decides a perfect result

PRIMARY.SUCCESS: the WEAKEST of the three p-values <= 0.05 AND the spanning rule satisfied
PRIMARY.SPANNING_RULE: the MATCHING heads must not all share one band layer, or CANNOT ANSWER whatever the p-values say
PRIMARY.HOW_THE_CLAIM_MUST_BE_STATED: with the WEAKEST of the three, each named. Quoting the binomial alone is FORBIDDEN.

⛔ THERE_IS_NO_SECONDARY_ANALYSIS.what_was_removed: the first freeze preregistered a SECONDARY over the five never-tested heads ([4, 10, 13, 18, 21]), with a floor of 0.008333.
⛔ THERE_IS_NO_SECONDARY_ANALYSIS.why_it_is_gone: R32-A: NOTHING IN THE REPOSITORY COULD COMPUTE IT. The reader produces one verdict over pr['heads']; a secondary would have been computed BY HAND AFTER THE READ. And its ⛔ NOT_A_FALLBACK guard did not bind: it was keyed on the PRIMARY 'failing', while the likeliest route to a rescue is CANNOT ANSWER (a tie under VOID 6, a spanning violation, K < 3) -- in which the primary has not failed and nothing forbade reporting a passing secondary.
⛔ THERE_IS_NO_SECONDARY_ANALYSIS.consequence: the three replication heads ([6, 11, 27]) stay IN the primary and are disclosed by name. No five-head analysis may be reported from this family at all; it would be a separate preregistration.

⛔ NO_POST_HOC_SHARPNESS_SUBSETTING.rule: the margins are frozen per head HERE precisely so that a margin-restricted subset reported after the read can be recognised as one. Reporting any such subset -- as the result, as a rescue of a null, or as a qualification of a positive -- IS FORBIDDEN.

ADMISSION.rule: head h is ADMITTED iff its whole-head arm HD_<h> has a ci95 excluding 0 AND |E(HD_<h>)| >= 1.5 x bar(h)
ADMISSION.COMPUTED_FROM: the whole-head arm ALONE, never from the cells
ADMISSION.A_DROPPED_HEAD_IS_NOT_A_MISS: it leaves K and is reported with its measured power
ADMISSION.EXPECTED: all eight are expected to be admitted -- S-347 measured their |E|/bar on PR-CSI-012's arms at 2.49 / 2.33 / 2.13 / 2.07 / 1.92 / 1.92 / 1.84 / 1.80 (heads 6, 18, 10, 21, 4, 11, 13, 27). Heads 27 and 13 are the THIN ones.
ADMISSION.⚠ THESE_ARE_EXPECTATIONS_NOT_THE_VERDICT: they come from PR-CSI-012's arms; this family recomputes admission from its OWN HD_<h> arms by the S-311 rule.
ADMISSION.✅ LOSING_A_THIN_HEAD_MAKES_THIS_FAMILY_S: heads 13 and 27 are the two that COLLIDE on L10. Dropping either breaks the tie and raises K_unique from 4 to 5, raising P(certify | q=0.83) from 0.8624 to ~0.9612 under the READER's statistic. PR-CSI-018 had the OPPOSITE exposure: losing either of its two unique-layer heads was fatal. ⚠ R33/S-359: this read '0.8563 to 0.9578 (S-348)' until now -- both S-348 figures, WITHDRAWN in S-352 as computed under the wrong statistic, and quantities this config did not witness (its own power block says 0.8623).

DETECTABILITY_PREREGISTERED_PER_HEAD.method: the S-311 RULE, computed at read time from this family's own HD_<h> arms

BAR_IS_A_RULE.rule: bar(h) = z * SD(per-domain paired delta of HD_<h> minus the base arm, ddof=1) / sqrt(n_domains)
BAR_IS_A_RULE.DDOF_IS_PINNED: S-318 verified ddof=1 reproduces published bars exactly
BAR_IS_A_RULE.WHY_NOT_A_NUMBER: a bar must come from the family it judges

DETECTABILITY_PREREGISTERED_PER_HEAD.⚠ NOT_HELD_OUT: THE SCREEN IS basket TRAIN AND THIS CENSUS IS basket VALIDATION, so the LAYER is held out on SPLIT ONLY -- **NOT on codeword**. PR-CSI-018 was held out on BOTH (a basket screen predicting BUTTON cells), so D39's framing is STRONGER than anything this family can claim and must not be carried over to it. The HEAD SET is chosen using PR-CSI-012's basket validation magnitudes, i.e. the SAME split this family reads. ⚠ THE FIRST FREEZE DEFENDED THIS WITH THE WRONG ARGUMENT -- that liveness is a whole-head property while the test is which CELL within a head. R32-A showed that defends the wrong thing: selecting heads on whole-head validation magnitude CAN tilt the marginal distribution of argmax layers, and BOTH the binomial and the conditional rest on a uniform-over-9 null that S-351 measured to be empirically wrong. WHAT ACTUALLY PROTECTS THE FAMILY is the PERMUTATION component: it conditions on the observed argmaxes, so a shared band bias cannot fake it, and because GATING is weakest_of_three the gate is valid whenever ANY ONE component is. PR-CSI-018's frozen read said this in terms; the first freeze of this family replaced it and lost the argument that works.
DETECTABILITY_PREREGISTERED_PER_HEAD.NOT_THE_PRIMARY: the bar governs the depth map's CLEARS/does-not-clear; the PRIMARY is argmax agreement and does not use the bar

POWER_BY_SEEDED_MONTE_CARLO.⚠ WHY_NOT_EXACT_ENUMERATION: the first freeze computed power as an exact sum over the 2^K match patterns. That is only possible if p depends on M ALONE -- which is true of the statistic that freeze used and FALSE of the reader's, where p is scored against the OBSERVED ARGMAX VECTOR and therefore depends on WHERE the misses land. S-353: two outcomes with identical M and identical M_unique can get different verdicts, so no exact table over match counts exists.
POWER_BY_SEEDED_MONTE_CARLO.model: each admitted head matches its prediction with probability q INDEPENDENTLY; a miss lands UNIFORMLY on one of the other 8 band layers

⚠ BOTH_HALVES_OF_THE_MODEL_ARE_ASSUMPTIO.independence: positive correlation across heads would widen the true spread and make these OPTIMISTIC
⚠ BOTH_HALVES_OF_THE_MODEL_ARE_ASSUMPTIO.uniform_misses: S-351 MEASURED that the empirical argmax marginal is NOT uniform -- over the 10 heads this sprint has cell-censused, L10 and L14 take 60%. So this half is known to be wrong IN DETAIL. R32-A computed the type I under the empirical marginal at 0.00306, BELOW the uniform figure, i.e. the error is in the conservative direction -- but that number is R32-A's and is NOT asserted here.

POWER_BY_SEEDED_MONTE_CARLO.TYPE_I: P(certify | q = 1/9) is recorded above. It is far below alpha = 0.05, which is the price of gating on the WEAKEST of three. A NULL from this family is therefore WEAK evidence against the screen, not strong. ⚠ The first freeze put this at 0.0004; under the reader's statistic it is ~0.0041 (S-354), an order of magnitude higher and still conservative.
POWER_BY_SEEDED_MONTE_CARLO.⚠ POWERED_FOR_A_STRONG_SCREEN: at q = 0.33 power is ~0.10 (the first freeze said ~0.05, which OVERSTATED the limitation). This family can confirm a screen that works; it cannot distinguish a mediocre screen from a useless one.

NECESSARY_CONDITIONS_FOR_CERTIFICATION.⚠ SCOPE: AT K = 8 WITH K_unique = 4 ONLY -- i.e. when ADMISSION drops nobody. If admission drops any head these MUST BE RECOMPUTED at the realised (K, K_unique) and are NOT these. R33/S-359 measured the failure: drop head 18 and K_unique falls to 3, where P(Binom(3,1/9) >= 2) = 0.03429355 <= alpha, so the conditional NO LONGER forces M_unique >= 3 -- and the reader duly published PASS at K=7, M=4, M_unique=2 (weakest = conditional 0.034294). The first re-freeze froze the rule UNQUALIFIED, which made it FALSE on an outcome this very prereg markets in its ADMISSION block.
NECESSARY_CONDITIONS_FOR_CERTIFICATION.why: P(Binom(8,1/9) >= 2) = 0.22051131 > alpha forces M >= 3; P(Binom(4,1/9) >= 2) = 0.06355738 > alpha forces M_unique >= 3. ⚠ P(Binom(8,1/9) >= 3) = 0.04999816 clears alpha by 1.8e-6 -- a knife edge, recorded because it is one.
NECESSARY_CONDITIONS_FOR_CERTIFICATION.how_to_recompute_if_K_drops: M_min = the smallest m with P(Binom(K,1/9) >= m) <= alpha; M_unique_min likewise with K_unique. Both are necessary; neither is sufficient.
NECESSARY_CONDITIONS_FOR_CERTIFICATION.⛔ NECESSARY_BUT_NOT_SUFFICIENT: S-353 exhibited 34 outcomes satisfying this rule that do NOT certify (e.g. M=3, M_unique=3, weakest 0.091071), because p_perm depends on where the misses land. NO rule in (M, M_unique) alone characterises certification, and this prereg does not pretend one does.

DOSE_EXPECTATION.STATUS: MEASURED (S-299, S-306, S-317, and S-335 on 62 arms)
DOSE_EXPECTATION.⚠ BLIND_AS_AN_IDENTITY: all 72 cell arms expect 224 and all 8 HD_ arms plus BK_KO expect 2016, so the dose cannot distinguish arms within either group. Identity MUST come from each run's own knockout_cells (S-292/S-310).

population.test_note: TEST is NEVER touched. S-314: it is ALSO already spent and selection-contaminated, so it is not an axis even in principle.

CENSUS_DELIVERABLE: 72 single-cell effects E(BK_H<h>_L<ll>) = the MEAN OVER THE 23 DOMAINS of (y_install(cell) - y_install(BK_BASE)), each with a percentile bootstrap ci95 over DOMAIN resamples; the eight whole-head HD_<h> arms supplying the S-311 bars and the ADMISSION decision, EXCLUDED from every per-cell count; and the BK_KO all-32 denominator. ⚠ The first freeze omitted this key entirely, so the census REFUSED the prereg before loading any arm -- after ~3.9 GPU-hours would have been spent (R32-A/R32-B). It is also where the ESTIMATOR is defined, so without it the family had no estimator definition anywhere, a PART I 3.5 violation.
DOSE_IDENTITY_IS_BLIND_HERE: 72 cell arms share a prefill dose of 224 and NINE arms share 2016 (the eight HD_<h> plus BK_KO). The dose therefore carries NO identity information within either group. Arm identity MUST be asserted from each run's own knockout_cells, and for BK_KO from its recording NO cell list (S-292/S-310).

ESTIMATOR_AND_RESAMPLER.estimator: per arm, E = mean over DOMAINS of the per-domain paired delta (arm minus BK_BASE). DOMAIN is the unit (PART I 3.1); rows never inflate n.

bootstrap.⚠ WHY_FROZEN_HERE: these were COMMAND-LINE DEFAULTS of scripts/dcs_csi_head_census.py, not preregistered quantities. Every published census used them, so this is a sprint-wide gap rather than a new one -- PR-CSI-020 is where it closes (R32-A CONCERN 2).

ESTIMATOR_AND_RESAMPLER.bar_rule: bar(h) = 1.96 * SD(per-domain paired delta of HD_<h> minus BK_BASE, ddof=1) / sqrt(23)

MEASURED_ARGMAX_MARGINAL_BEFORE_THIS_FAM.what: the marginal distribution of the INTERVENTION argmax layer over the 10 heads this sprint had cell-censused before PR-CSI-020 (PR-014, PR-015, PR-018)
MEASURED_ARGMAX_MARGINAL_BEFORE_THIS_FAM.⚠ IT_IS_NOT_UNIFORM: L10 and L14 take 60% of ten heads against a uniform 11.1% each, and this family predicts L10 twice and L14 once. A random screen predicting THIS multiset would match at ~0.1625, not 1/9 = 0.1111 (S-351), so THE BINOMIAL p IS ANTI-CONSERVATIVE FOR THIS MULTISET.
MEASURED_ARGMAX_MARGINAL_BEFORE_THIS_FAM.why_the_family_is_still_valid: the PERMUTATION p conditions on the observed argmaxes and the CONDITIONAL runs over unique-layer heads, so a favourable marginal cancels in both; and under weakest_of_three the binomial is always the smallest of the three and never gates. This is exactly why S-317/S-319 moved the gating off the binomial.
MEASURED_ARGMAX_MARGINAL_BEFORE_THIS_FAM.⛔ NOT_A_CORRECTED_NULL: 0.1625 is a DIAGNOSTIC and must not be substituted into anything. Building a 'corrected binomial' after seeing this marginal would be the post-hoc statistic-selection this sprint forbids.

NO_RANK_TEST: this family carries no control pool and no rank; the rank tooling must refuse it

VOID_CONDITIONS.5: the screen artefact's md5 differs from artifact_md5_at_freeze

VOID_CONDITIONS.10: attn_implementation != eager on any arm. ⚠ RESTORED; enforced by NO code -- it is checked by reading each arm's config at read time
VOID_CONDITIONS.11: scripts/ or src/ edited while arms are in flight. ⚠ RESTORED; enforced by NO code. The launcher records the commit at submit (CSI_GIT_BLOB), and R30-D measured that per-arm RUNMETA git_commit names the code that ran for only the FIRST arm, so the launcher's BLOB line is the family's commit of record
VOID_CONDITIONS.12: the frozen READ amended after any number from this family is seen. ⚠ RESTORED
VOID_CONDITIONS.⚠ WHICH OF THESE ARE ACTUALLY ENFORCED B: 1, 3, 4, 6, 7 and 8 are. 2 is enforced by the census's base-arm identity check (S-332). 5, 9, 10, 11 and 12 are PROSE, checked by the operator at read time. R32-B found that condition 5 in particular -- the screen md5 -- is read by no reader, gate or test, which is the R29/VOID-8 shape one condition over. It is recorded as prose HERE rather than silently implied to be automatic.

WHAT_THIS_CANNOT_ANSWER: whether the screen predicts for heads that are NULL on basket -- this family admits only live ones, by construction
anything about the OTHER 24 heads, or about cells outside band 6-14
anything about the SOURCE of the effect (S-316/AM-40 stand; the mass instrument's criterion licenses a REFUTATION reading only, S-337/S-343)
whether the screen's sub-argmax ORDERING transfers -- S-307 measured that it does not
MUST_NOT_BE_SAID_IF_POSITIVE: the binomial p alone -- the claim is the WEAKEST of the three, each named. ⚠ This now has a MEASURED reason and not only a methodological one: S-351 measured that for THIS prediction multiset a random screen would match at ~0.1625 against the binomial's assumed 1/9, so quoting it alone would be quantitatively misleading by ~46%, not merely incomplete
that this is held out on codeword -- IT IS NOT. Split only. D39 is the cross-codeword result; this is not, and conflating them would overstate both
'cell (L, h) is the writer' -- there is STILL no control family of ARBITRARY cells anywhere in this sprint. This is NECESSITY, rung 1 of AM-34's ladder
that the screen is a validated cell selector IN GENERAL -- eight heads, every one chosen BECAUSE it was live on basket
any margin-restricted subset of the eight
that D37 is superseded -- D37 is descriptive and stands; this ADDS a preregistered p
MUST_NOT_BE_SAID_IF_NULL: that the screen is useless -- type I here is far below alpha and power at a MEDIOCRE screen (q = 0.33) is ~0.10, so a null is WEAK evidence against it. ⚠ R33/S-359: this sentence said ~0.05 until now, which is S-348's WITHDRAWN figure computed under the wrong permutation statistic. The reader COPIES this list verbatim into the published verdict on a FAIL, so a null would have shipped a withdrawn number into the artefact
that D39 is withdrawn -- D39 stands on its own preregistered read of button
that D37 is withdrawn -- D37 is descriptive and rests on its own arms
that the basket depth structure is absent -- D36/D37 measured it directly
SELECTION_RE_ENTERS_WHEN: any head is added, re-ordered, or dropped OTHER THAN BY THE FROZEN ADMISSION RULE, after an arm has run. ⚠ The first freeze said 'added, dropped or re-ordered' without that exception, which contradicted ADMISSION -- whose whole job is to drop heads after the arms have run (R32-A CONCERN 5).
